note: The ten source driver states remain unchanged. running/mismatch are presentation aliases only. Factor delivery and code views are an orthogonal task model, not additional proof-driver states. Production recovery must follow the driver's capabilities.

tone.title: Host family, Medium 500, 20/24
tone.action: Deep teal #145C52 text action, 44 px target
tone.boundary: A completed browser response permits the host flow to continue to server verification. The text does not certify a person, authorize an operation or override the application's disposition.

worker-unavailable.title: Couldn't start the check
worker-unavailable.explanation: Try again, or contact the site.

execution-unavailable.title: Couldn't finish the check
execution-unavailable.explanation: Try again, or contact the site.

recoveryContract.pending: No extra human control; application invokes execute.
recoveryContract.idle: Native retry when provided by the driver.
recoveryContract.done: Host continues to authoritative server verification; later expiry remains possible.
recoveryContract.failed: Retry may reacquire or rerun the demanded flow.
recoveryContract.expired: Clear token and bindings; preserve the host form; retry reacquires.
recoveryContract.worker-unavailable: Retry can reacquire; no silent memory-hard downgrade.
recoveryContract.execution-unavailable: Retry reruns the flow; required evidence remains required.
recoveryContract.solver-mismatch: Reload a coherent asset set; never accept mismatched output.
